title: Tidewater Almanac
summary: A new identity for a working harbour, drawn from a century of tide tables and the marks painted on its sea wall. The logo redraws itself each day from that morning's high water.

title: Saltgrass Ferments
summary: Forty jars, one label system, and a colour for every week of the fermenting calendar. Customers now read a shelf the way the makers read a batch.

title: Low Tide Sound
summary: Posters for a three-night festival held on a beach that exists only when the sea allows it. Each edition was printed in step with the tide chart and pulled from the walls once the water came back.

title: Hollow Oak Press
summary: A series design for a small publisher of translated poetry, built on one strict grid and two weights of type. Sixty years of backlist now sits together on a single shelf.

title: The Ferrous Archive
summary: A public archive of nine thousand foundry drawings, indexed by shape as well as by date. Visitors can sketch a curve and find the casting that matches it.

title: Night Ferry
summary: Signage for a ferry service that runs mostly after dark, tested on deck in rain and low light. The numerals are cut wide enough to read from a moving car ramp.
